name: @wm/client
description: WorldMonitor browser modules the Lite UI builds on: services/ (runtime, bootstrap, RPC clients, session), config/, types/, utils/, bootstrap/ (Sentry and RUM), shared/ (premium and public RPC path lists) and locales/. The Lite UI and tests import @wm/client/<dir>/<file> by name; files inside this package import each other by relative path. api/, packages/server/, packages/shared/, middleware.ts and apps/web/vite.dev-api.ts reach the modules they need (shared/, the trade-route and chokepoint config, utils/summary-cache-key) by relative path, never as @wm/client, and those modules use relative imports only (lint:boundaries Check 5). A .ts module is imported without its extension and .json files name theirs; @wm/client/types resolves to types/index.ts. There is deliberately no ./*.ts key: Vite 6 compiles the dot in a pattern key's suffix as a regex wildcard.
